## VLSM 계산 순서

### 전체 토폴로지

!/assets/image_4c5117a0-9efd-4cc3-b509-e8f22f1d6cfa.png

서브넷 구간은 총 4개. 구간 A, B, E, M

먼저 132.100.0.0/16 영역

필요 Host 순 기준 정령

## 132.100.0.0/16 영역

- B구간 (R2 LAN)

1022개 호스트 사용 가능. 대역대 132.100.0.0 ~ 132.100.3.254.

최소 host: 132.100.0.11

loopback: 132.100.0.0

BroadCast: 132.100.0.11

```
Address:132.100.0.010000100.01100100.000000 00.00000000
Netmask:255.255.252.0 = 2211111111.11111111.111111 00.00000000
Wildcard:0.0.3.25500000000.00000000.000000 11.11111111
=>
Network:132.100.0.0/22   10000100.01100100.000000 00.00000000 (Class B)
Broadcast:132.100.3.255  10000100.01100100.000000 11.11111111
HostMin:132.100.0.11     0000100.01100100.000000 00.00000001
HostMax:132.100.3.254    10000100.01100100.000000 11.11111110
Hosts/Net:1022
```

- A 구간 (R1 LAN)

510개 호스트 사용 가능. 대역대 132.100.4.0 ~ 132.100.5.255

최소 host: 132.100.4.1

loopback: 132.100.4.0

BroadCast: 132.100.5.255

```
Address:132.100.4.0  10000100.01100100.0000010 0.00000000
Netmask:255.255.254.0 = 2311111111.11111111.1111111 0.00000000
Wildcard:0.0.1.255  00000000.00000000.0000000 1.11111111
=>
Network:132.100.4.0/23   10000100.01100100.0000010 0.00000000 (Class B)
Broadcast:132.100.5.255  10000100.01100100.0000010 1.11111111
HostMin:132.100.4.1       10000100.01100100.0000010 0.00000001
HostMax:132.100.5.254     10000100.01100100.0000010 1.11111110
Hosts/Net:510
```

- E 구간 (R1 LAN)

30개 호스트 사용 가능. 대역대 132.100.0.0 ~ 132.100.3.254.

최소 host: 132.100.6.1

loopback: 132.100.6.0

BroadCast: 132.100.6.31

30개

```

Address:132.100.6.0   1  0000100.01100100.00000110.000 00000
Netmask:255.255.255.224 = 2711111111.11111111.11111111.111 00000
Wildcard:0.0.0.31        00000000.00000000.00000000.000 11111
=>
Network:132.100.6.0/27   10000100.01100100.00000110.000 00000 (Class B)
Broadcast:132.100.6.31  10000100.01100100.00000110.000 11111
HostMin:132.100.6.1     10000100.01100100.00000110.000 00001
HostMax:132.100.6.30    10000100.01100100.00000110.000 11110
Hosts/Net:30
```

- M 구간 (R1-R2 LAN)’

2개 사용가능.

132.100.6.32 ~ 132.100.6.34

최소 host: 132.100.6.33

loopback: 132.100.6.32

BroadCast: 132.100.6.34

```
Address:132.100.6.32       10000100.01100100.00000110.001000 00
Netmask:255.255.255.252 = 3011111111.11111111.11111111.111111 00
Wildcard:0.0.0.3           00000000.00000000.00000000.000000 11
=>
Network:132.100.6.32/30    10000100.01100100.00000110.001000 00 (Class B)
Broadcast:132.100.6.35     10000100.01100100.00000110.001000 11
HostMin:132.100.6.33       10000100.01100100.00000110.001000 01
HostMax:132.100.6.34       10000100.01100100.00000110.001000 10
Hosts/Net:2
```

## 81.0.0.0/8

구간 C, D, F, P입니다.

### 인터페이스 IP예시

### 중앙 WAN 198.133.100.0/24 영역

중앙은 라우터 간 Serial 링크이므로 전부 /30으로 나누면 됩니다.
